{{2010–11 Southern Conference men's basketball standings}}
The '''2010–11 College of Charleston Cougars men's basketball team''' represented the [[College of Charleston]] in the [[2010–11 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Cougars, led by head coach [[Bobby Cremins]], played their home games at [[TD Arena|Carolina First Arena]] in [[Charleston, South Carolina]], as members of the [[Southern Conference]]. The Cougars won a share of the regular-season title in the Southern Conference, and advanced to the championship game of the [[2011 Southern Conference men's basketball tournament|SoCon tournament]], where they were defeated by [[2010–11 Wofford Terriers men's basketball team|Wofford]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Wofford earns 2nd straight NCAA bid by topping Bobby Cremins' Cougars |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap/_/gameId/310660232 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230116105055/https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap/_/gameId/310660232 |url-status=dead |archive-date=January 16, 2023 |publisher=[[ESPN]] |date=March 8, 2011 |access-date=January 16, 2023}}</ref>

College of Charleston failed to qualify for the [[2011 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]], but received an automatic bid to the [[2011 National Invitation Tournament|2011 NIT]] as the regular-season champions of the Southern Conference. The Cougars advanced to the quarterfinals of the NIT, where they were eliminated by eventual champions [[2010–11 Wichita State Shockers men's basketball team|Wichita State]], 82–75.<ref>{{cite web |title=Gabe Blair, J.T. Durley earn road trip to Madison Square Garden for Wichita State |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap/_/gameId/310822724 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230116105050/https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap/_/gameId/310822724 |url-status=dead |archive-date=January 16, 2023 |publisher=[[ESPN]] |date=March 24, 2011 |access-date=January 16, 2023}}</ref>
